services.name: Jetty Fishing Charter
services.desc: Duration 4 hours or 6 hours About Our Jetty Charters are aboard our 30’ Panga Center Console SeaPlay I. Our boat offers 360-degree fishability that can be expected from Center Consoles. They are the preferred boat for those enjoying a little more comfort while they fish. Our Galveston Jetty Charter is a short 20 minute boat ride to the fishing grounds. These trips provide the opportunity to get many different species of fish ranging from a few pounds to over 100 lbs. The species if fish you can see on these trips include redfish, speckle trout, flounder, sheepshead, drum, mackerel, and many others including large stingrays and sharks. services.name: Shark Charter
services.desc: Duration 5 hours About This trip is for those who seek the adrenaline-charged thrill of catching a large shark. During the warm summer months, the waters of Galveston are the perfect place to intercept these large predators. We fish shrimp boats, nearshore rigs, anchored ships, and other locations that large sharks frequent. Encounters with large sharks exceeding 100lbs are not uncommon. All of these charters are offered aboard SeaPlay I. The trip length is usually 5 hours. More info 5 hour trip Available May 1st thru August 31st. 6 angler max No Fuel Charge Departs dock at 6:30am All bait and tackle is provided. Plus we clean and bag your catch at the dock. blurb: SeaPlay Sportfishing offers world class Galveston, Texas fishing and over 50 years experience right here on Galveston Island. We are a full-time saltwater fishing charter service offering charters ranging from the inshore waters of Galveston Bay to the clear blue waters found offshore. You will find our boat to be clean, well maintained and offering the safety of twin engines. Captain Brad is Coast Guard licensed
